summary: Iteration 12 – Full proxy audit for Cadabra as requested. Verified every indexer + relayer endpoint via /api/bifrost/v1/* matches upstream veilit.xyz and that both order flows (classic DarkSwap + NEAR intents) create real orders with deposit addresses. Backend: new pytest suite test_iter12_proxy_audit.py – 25/25 PASS (indexer parity 10 endpoints, relayer parity 6 endpoints + quote/bridge-quote/prepare/relay-400, 25-sequential-quote burst with 100% JSON bodies / zero HTML leak, no-HTML on 404, DS private-route full order flow, NEAR 1Click full order flow with retry-on-stale-quote). Frontend: Private route E2E in browser – entered SOL 0.5 → USDC Ethereum, EVM 0x68b3…41f6, CTA transitioned 'Fetching quote…' → 'Review swap' in 6s, clicked, 'Order created' modal rendered with id c8GFceMHusMupqdT7qfsct, 50.3672 USDC out, Solana deposit addr 6FKM2zH8UqXcuH5SqtwHs65oUntJu62L8ZcXvJpwQ1jz, 29:59 countdown, 'Track this order' CTA, no DarkSwap/Houdini branding leaked, no dk-error. Privacy swap E2E: SOL 5 → ETH Ethereum, same recipient, refund Solana 5tzFkiKscXHK5…vuAi9, CTA 'Review swap' enabled, click triggered Cadabra's branded 'Quick security check / Verify' modal – this is the Cloudflare page-level challenge from upstream near-intents gateway documented in iter 11, no 400 or app bug (same quoteId POSTs server-side return 200 depositAddress, verified in pytest test_ds_near_privacy_swap_full_order). Right-rail live pool stats ('What the chain sees') render with Merkle root, 1058 commitments, 278 nullifiers, 49/72 verified tokens, live private trade feed – all through proxy with no HTML leaks. GatewayStatusMiddleware correctly returns JSON 503 with x-upstream-status when upstream Jupiter 429s (observed on quote #10 of burst).

integration_issues.issue: Upstream near-intents.network edge intermittently serves a Cloudflare page-level challenge during order creation; the app's branded 'Quick security check – Verify' modal handles it gracefully but blocks automated E2E. Same POST /api/ds/near/orders succeeds 200 with depositAddress via server (pytest). Not an app regression.

action_items: No functional fixes required for the proxy audit – 25/25 backend tests pass and both order creation flows produce real deposit addresses.
(Optional UX) Consider auto-retrying the 'Quick security check' submit after user Verify tap closes the challenge modal, instead of requiring user to re-click Review swap.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/bifrost.py proxy() retry/backoff on upstream 429 is working – burst of 25 sequential quotes yielded 24 x 200 JSON + 1 x 503 JSON (never HTML). The 503 cleanly wraps upstream Jupiter 'Too many requests' – good.

GatewayStatusMiddleware is correctly intercepting upstream 502/504/HTML and converting to JSON 503 with x-upstream-status; verified with /api/bifrost/v1/indexer/v1/this-does-not-exist-xyz and burst test.
backend/brand/dk-swap.js is still ~1100 lines in one file; previous iter's splitting recommendation stands.

Indexer /v1/logo/ returns upstream 404 for unknown mints – this is passthrough and acceptable; frontend should swallow logo 404s silently (console shows a lot of 404s during feed render – consider adding onerror handler on tags).

Console shows many 429 errors during live feed polling – these are upstream rate limits on the referrals / asset-icon fetches, not proxy bugs. Consider frontend-side exponential backoff on these polling calls.

success_rate.frontend: Private route 100% E2E (order id c8GFceMHusMupqdT7qfsct created with deposit address). Privacy swap: CTA + validation 100%, live submit blocked once by upstream Cloudflare challenge (handled by branded Verify modal, documented upstream behaviour not an app bug; same flow verified 200 via pytest).

seed_data_creation: Created 1 real upstream Private-route order via browser (c8GFceMHusMupqdT7qfsct, 0.5 SOL → 50.3672 USDC on Ethereum). Pytest also created 1 classic DS order + 1 NEAR 1Click order with deposit addresses returned – no funds moved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend proxy for every veilit.xyz endpoint is confirmed parity with upstream (25-case pytest in test_iter12_proxy_audit.py). All order flows are 200 end to end. The only transient browser-level issue is Cloudflare's own 'Quick security check' challenge on near-intents.network submits – app handles it gracefully with the branded Verify modal, user just taps Verify once then resubmits. No HTML page leak through any proxy endpoint. GatewayStatusMiddleware properly converts upstream 429/502/504 to JSON 503. Private route live order id for traceability: c8GFceMHusMupqdT7qfsct (GET /api/ds/orders/c8GFceMHusMupqdT7qfsct returns status).
